description: Assume every total recursive index transformation has a semantic fixed point. For every binary partial recursive \(g\), there is \(q\) with \(\varphi_q(\langle a,x\rangle)\simeq g(a,x)\) for all \(a,x\); the map \(f(a)=s(q,a)\) is primitive recursive and has a semantic fixed point \(e\) satisfying \(\varphi_e(x)\simeq g(e,x)\) for every \(x\).
